quote.text: If you want to be respected, start by respecting yourself.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood: By cultivating self-respect, you model for your children the importance of caring for oneself, which in turn teaches them to nurture their own well-being.
  • Parenthood: When you honor your own values and boundaries, you set a clear example about how respect should be both given and received within the family.
  • Leadership: A leader who practices self-respect instills trust within the team; your integrity becomes the foundation for collective respect and accountability.
  • Leadership: Upholding self-respect encourages decisive and fair decision-making, guiding you to act with genuine confidence that others will naturally follow.
  • Product Management: In managing products, respecting your vision and expertise is essential; it empowers you to confidently advocate for the best solutions even amidst challenging feedback.
  • Product Management: Self-respect in your role ensures that you remain true to your principles, fostering an environment where innovation and thoughtful progress are both valued and driven by integrity.
